name: Roth.normOne_eq_sum_of_support_subset
signature:
theorem normOne_eq_sum_of_support_subset {P : MvPolynomial σ ℤ} {s : Finset (σ →₀ ℕ)}
    (hs : P.support ⊆ s) : normOne P = ∑ d ∈ s, |((P.coeff d : ℤ) : ℝ)|
body: Finset.sum_subset hs fun d _ hd ↦ by simp [notMem_support_iff.1 hd]
what: The norm can be summed over any finite superset of the support.
how: Finset.sum_subset adds only zero coefficients outside the support.
hypotheses: A finite exponent set containing the polynomial support.
